text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 is treated with antiviral medications and supportive care, depending on the severity of the illness and individual risk factors. For those at high risk of severe illness, oral antivirals like Nirmatrelvir with Ritonavir (Paxlovid) or Molnupiravir (Lagevrio) may be prescribed for at-home treatment. Remdesivir (Veklury) is another antiviral, administered intravenously in a healthcare facility, and can be used for both those at high risk and those hospitalized with more severe illness. Treatment should be guided by a healthcare professional, and it's important to seek medical advice promptly if you have symptoms, according to the Wisconsin Department of Health Services (.gov).
